title: RIZO Skeleton Crewneck
description:
The RIZO Skeleton Crewneck brings back an original design with updated artwork and an upgraded sweatshirt. Bone-inspired RIZO lettering sits above a detailed skeleton graphic, with hand-drawn accents throughout. On the back, RIZO’s signature face and minimal markings complete the design.

Made from 8.5 oz (280 GSM) cotton/polyester three-end fleece, this crewneck features a standard fit, ring-spun cotton face yarn, and durable construction.

Product details

  • Color: Black with white printed graphics
  • 8.5 oz / 280 GSM cotton-polyester 3-end fleece
  • Ring-spun cotton, 32-singles face yarn
  • Standard fit
  • Split-stitch double-needle sewing
  • Twill neck tape
  • 1×1 ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem

Designed by RIZO Apparel.
